Example single-cell circadian dataset

Source: R/data.R
srb_example_data.Rd

A simulated example dataset used to demonstrate the scRhythmBayes workflow. The object contains count data and cell-level metadata for testing cell-phase inference, gene-level rhythmic parameter estimation, rhythm-state module analysis, OVR analysis, DTW similarity analysis, and phase-rho summaries.

Usage

srb_example_data

Format

A list with three elements:

Count

A sparse 138 gene by 2,160 cell count matrix.

meta

Cell metadata containing cell, biological sample, replicate, ZT, celltype, condition, true phase (T_true, Theta_true), and simulated noisy phase inputs (Theta_noisy, r_sim). The data contain 36 samples: two conditions by six ZT values by three replicates.

truth

A list containing gene-level M0–M7 and OVR truth, sample design, native sample-specific mesor and phase effects, and the simulation settings.

Source

Simulated for the scRhythmBayes teaching workflow with data-raw/generate_srb_example_data.R.

Details

Counts were generated from a sample-aware negative-binomial model with mean-dependent zero inflation. Biological samples have native sample-specific mesor and phase perturbations. The 24 phase-seed genes use mouse gene symbols, including Arntl, Clock, Cry1, Cry2, and Per1--Per3. Simulated phase columns are retained as ground truth and are not outputs from infer_cell_phase().
